slice: engine2: exhaust, pistons/top end, cams, cooling/intake gaps

variants: Titanium shell, stainless internals, stainless manifold
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims via retailer: +1.8 kW (2.5 hp) at 10,300 rpm and +1.5 Nm at 7,900 rpm vs stock on Akrapovič's dyno; claimed 26.5% lighter than stock.
products.caveats: Retailer description also mentions CRF450X, conflicting with its title; confirm. Closed-course competition use only. Retailer metadata lists 15.5 kg, which is likely shipping weight.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claim: weight reduction and more engine performance; meets FIM noise limits. No figures given on the retailer page.
products.caveats: Page shows 3 in stock but also 'coming back soon'.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims via dealer: 0.9 kg (20.4%) lighter than stock; +1.8 kW (2.4 hp) at 10,600 rpm and +1.5 Nm at 10,500 rpm vs stock; plug-and-play, no remap needed; FIM noise compliant.
products.caveats: Part number taken from the dealer's URL slug (ak-s-y4met16-fdhlta), not a labelled field. Racer X covered the launch in April 2023. Closed-course use only.

products.what_it_changes: KTM listing claims (unquantified): substantial weight saving, more usable power and finer throttle response, manifold routing matched to the production engine, FIM/AMA noise compliant.
products.caveats: 250/350 only; 450 Evolution not found this pass. Page shows both 'In Stock' and 'Coming soon'. Husqvarna/GasGas OEM-catalogue equivalents not checked.

products.what_it_changes: KTM listing claims: titanium for low weight, welded brackets, FIM noise compliant, more power and torque from optimised gas flow (no figures).
products.caveats: Superseded for 2026 SX-F by A47005979000 per KTM Direct listings; 2026 overlap on this page needs checking.

products.what_it_changes: KTM listing claims: substantial weight saving and significantly more performance; FIM noise compliant. No figures.
products.caveats: Also lists 450 SMR (out of scope).

products.what_it_changes: KTM listing claims: weight saving, gains across the rev range, sharper throttle response (no figures).
products.caveats: 2026 SX-F models only (plus Factory Editions and 450 SMR). Dealer text says 'track and street use', which is doubtful for a competition muffler.

variants: 1-into-1, titanium, titanium end cap, no spark arrestor
products.what_it_changes: Maker claim: maximises engine performance and cuts weight; retailer lists 1.23 kg (no power figures).
products.caveats: Listed as currently unavailable. No spark arrestor, so not for spark-arrestor-required trail riding.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims shown by retailer: about 3.2 kg vs 4.5 kg stock (about 30% lighter); peak power 55.5 hp vs 54.1 hp stock, with a claimed best-point gain of +2.6 hp; torque 33.7 vs 32.4 lb-ft.
products.caveats: Retailer's claim table is garbled in places (rpm points swapped); check the Akrapovič dyno chart. Competition only. Stock status contradicts itself.

variants: Titanium head pipe, titanium spark-arrested muffler

fits.notes: Monster Energy and 70th Anniversary editions listed
Retailer also lists 2024, which is not in the app's YZ250FX year list

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: 30-40% lighter than a stainless system; more performance across the rpm range (no figures); FIM noise compliant; spark arrester fitted.
products.caveats: Also fits WR250F (out of scope). Competition use only.

variants: Maciag set no. SID169453 = pipe + silencer
Maciag SID158665 = silencer only (aluminium, carbon end cap)
products.what_it_changes: Claims: pipe gives a noticeable gain in the mid-to-upper rpm range; silencer adds power while staying within dB limits. Pipe is untreated (raw) steel and reuses OEM mounting hardware.
products.supporting_parts: Silencer uses the OEM exhaust bulb and brackets.
products.caveats: SID numbers are retailer product numbers, not HGS part numbers. Listed as sold out. Made in the Netherlands.

products.what_it_changes: No claims on the retailer page.
products.caveats: No part number or price shown (image file name XT-123-H00 is unconfirmed). Husqvarna TC 125 / GasGas MC 125 equivalents not checked.

products.what_it_changes: No claims on the retailer page.
products.caveats: No part number or price shown (image file name YT-205-H00 is unconfirmed). Fitment for YZ250X not stated.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: more horsepower and torque across the rev range; stamped AKDQ carbon steel, hand-welded seams, reinforced brackets; made in USA.
products.caveats: Currency not stated (AU retailer, likely AUD). Raw finish rusts without oiling. Out of stock. 300 SX and Husqvarna/GasGas 250 fitment not stated on this page.

products.what_it_changes: Seller claims: performance gains from optimised exhaust flow; AKDQ carbon steel, hand-welded seams, integrated stinger, bolt-on; made in USA. 5.8 lb shipping weight.
products.caveats: RevZilla titles the same pipe 'KTM / Husqvarna / Gas Gas 125cc 2023-2027' without a model list, so TC 125 / MC 125 and later years are unverified. Platinum (plated) version for these bikes was not found this pass.

products.what_it_changes: No claims on the retailer page; a shorty silencer is generally fitted for weight and a freer top end, at the cost of noise.
products.caveats: No part number or price shown (image file name suggests DEPY2216, unconfirmed). Check local sound limits.

variants: 304 stainless header and mid-pipe, brushed aluminium hex muffler, carbon end cap
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: 'significant' horsepower and torque gains, deeper but tolerable tone, less heat. Handmade in USA.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 5/5 average from 2 reviews, no text shown
products.caveats: Competition use only. Big Gun was not on the task list but filled the Bill's Pipes gap (Bill's Pipes only listed for mini bikes).

variants: 40306M09500A = size A (listed by same retailer; details not read)
products.what_it_changes: Claims: forged high-silicon alloy piston for strength and longevity at stock-like 13.1:1 compression. Kit includes rings and circlips.
products.caveats: Match the A/B size code to the cylinder grade. Also lists 450 SM-R and FS 450 (out of scope).

products.what_it_changes: Claims: higher compression for torque and throttle response; ArmorGlide skirt coating to cut friction; pressure-seal ring groove. Kit has piston, rings, pin, circlips.
products.supporting_parts: Replacement rings 9600ZV, pin 748-2050-16-93C, circlips CW19 (per retailer).
products.caveats: High compression may need higher-octane fuel; check piston-to-valve clearance. Coyote Direct also lists a 2017-2020 13.5:1 kit WIS40177M09600.

fits.notes: Incl. 2024 50th Anniversary and 2023 Monster Energy editions

products.what_it_changes: Raises compression for more torque/response (Wiseco forged piston, tight-tolerance claims).
products.caveats: Backordered. Bore not listed. Higher compression than stock; fuel choice matters.

products.what_it_changes: Forged replacement piston at near-stock compression (maker claims tight tolerances and strength).
products.caveats: Backordered. Bore not listed. 2025+ YZ450F fitment not confirmed.

variants: 13.5:1; a 13.0:1 sibling PK1952 is also listed by Coyote Direct

fits.notes: Retailer lists 2020 and 2022 only; 2021 is not listed

products.what_it_changes: Raised-compression forged piston for more torque and response (maker claims).
products.caveats: Backordered. 2021 gap in fitment list is odd and should be checked with Wiseco.

products.what_it_changes: Raised-compression forged piston (maker claims performance and strength).
products.caveats: Backordered. 2022-2023 KX450 (non-X) not listed on this page; 2024+ KX450 Wiseco kit not found.

variants: 78.00mm standard bore, 14.1:1; A and B size codes
products.what_it_changes: Claims: high compression for torque and throttle response, ArmorGlide skirt coating, pressure-seal groove.
products.caveats: Retailer page mixes the A and B numbers; title says 2022 only, description says 2021-2022.

variants: 78mm bore, 14.4:1; A and B size codes
products.what_it_changes: Higher compression than stock for torque (maker claims). Includes ring set 7800YB, pin S677, clips W6883.
products.caveats: Out of stock. Not for 2023+ 250 SX-F (new 81mm engine).

variants: Piston, rings, pin, clips, gasket kit
products.what_it_changes: Complete top-end rebuild in one box (forged piston plus gaskets).
products.caveats: Bore/compression not stated. Retailer text mentions a top-end bearing, which does not apply to four-strokes.

products.what_it_changes: OEM-spec replacement timing chain (maker claims consistent valve timing, OEM-or-better durability).
products.caveats: Title says 2023-25 but fitment list says 450 SX-F to 2026.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: forged, built above OEM spec, team tested. Includes rings, pin, clips.
products.caveats: Compression not stated. Other size codes (A/C) not checked.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: forged, built above OEM spec, team tested.
products.caveats: Compression not stated. Also lists EXC-F/FE 250 and EC-F 250 2024 (out of scope). 250 XC-F not named.

products.what_it_changes: OE-quality cast replacement made in Japan; cross-references Yamaha piston numbers. Budget rebuild rather than a performance upgrade.
products.caveats: Retailer title and fitment list disagree on WR450F years. Pro-X also lists a 2023-2025 KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas 450 kit on RevZilla (no part numbers shown).

products.what_it_changes: Forged race piston with slightly raised compression (no maker claims on the page).
products.caveats: Price from page metadata. Later YZ450F years not stated.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: forged piston with a profiled pin bore to handle stress around the wrist pin in high-load race use.
products.caveats: URL says 78mm but page says 81mm (81mm matches the 2023+ engine). Page also lists Husqvarna FC 250 with unclear years. Seller advises checking piston-to-valve clearance.

products.what_it_changes: Forged piston made in the USA (maker marketing).
products.caveats: No model years, bore or compression listed, so fitment could not be mapped. JEP260955 is the retailer SKU. Page calls it an ATV piston.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: more power and torque at low and mid rpm while staying manageable; no changes to engine cases needed. Kit includes cylinder, forged piston, pin, rings and gaskets.
products.supporting_parts: Use Athena's spare gasket kit on every rebuild; maker warns not to use OE gaskets.
products.caveats: Displacement moves the bike out of the 250 class for racing. Compression and mapping needs not stated.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: more mid-range torque and throttle response; drop-in with stock springs.
products.caveats: Earlier pass covered Hot Cams to 2022; may be a duplicate. No 2023+ KTM Hot Cams found.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: horsepower and torque gains (no figures); works with stock springs.
products.caveats: May duplicate the earlier pass. Usually needs a matching map to get the gain.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: coarse outer and fine inner foam fused together so dirt cannot pack between layers; thick greaseless sealing ring.
products.caveats: GasGas MC 450F and KTM 300 SX are not in the retailer's list even though sister models are; check. Factory Edition 2022 models also listed.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: bonded dual-layer foam; flow-bench tests cited for more airflow and less clogging.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 average from 43 reviews, no text shown
products.caveats: Twin Air part number not shown on the page.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: fused dual-stage foam, greaseless sealing ring.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 average from 43 reviews (shared rating), no text shown
products.caveats: Twin Air part number not shown on the page.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: replaces the stock backfire screen with backfire-resistant foam and opens up airbox space for more airflow and power.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 average from 11 reviews, no text shown
products.caveats: GasGas MC-F is on a separate Twin Air kit page. Removing the backfire screen may matter for spark-arrester rules. Twin Air part number not shown.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: corrugated foam doubles filter surface area; soft-seal edge; Australian made.
products.supporting_parts: Uni recommends its Filter Fix air filter oil.
products.caveats: Source is a 2023 press article ('2023 onwards'); only 2023 mapped (FX 350 also named but has no 2023 model year in app scope). AU part numbers; US Uni NU-series number not confirmed.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: replaces OEM filter and cage, removing the factory backfire screen for more airflow to the throttle body; polymer cage with built-in anti-backfire screen; heat-sealed two-stage foam.
products.caveats: Retailer shows model names but only 'mostly 2022-2027' style year ranges; years here follow the 2023-2026 title and are not per-model verified. Two-stroke models (TX 300, EX 250/300) also appear in the list for this four-stroke kit, which looks wrong.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: profile-cut single-density foam adds surface area, holds airflow longer between cleans. Ships unoiled.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 average from 3 reviews, no text shown
products.caveats: FunnelWeb part number not shown.

products.what_it_changes: Claims: profile-cut foam, more surface area, longer service intervals. Ships unoiled.
products.caveats: The KTM part of the fitment list was cut off on the page; 2023+ KTM SX/SX-F/XC almost certainly share this filter but are not mapped here. TX 300 not visible.

products.what_it_changes: Sold as a performance upgrade; no claims on the page.
products.caveats: No part number or price shown. Turned up while searching for Lightspeed (which was not found).

gaps: Mishimoto: only 2010-2012-era YZ450F/KX450F radiators found on mishimoto.com; no 2020+ in-scope fitment.
Fluidyne: Slavens Racing KTM page lists only up to 2016 and says 'no longer available'; no 2020+ Fluidyne radiators found.
CV4 hose kits: Cycle Gear Y-kit lists only pre-2017 KTM/Kawasaki; JJ Motorsports CV4 pages (SFSMBC47R, SFSMBC55R) did not load their fitment lists.
Arrow: no motocross (SX/MX) exhaust found, only street and CFMoto/KTM road models.
LeoVince: X3 Evo listings found only for EXC-F enduro (out of scope); no MX fitment found.
Bill's Pipes: only KLX110-type mini-bike systems found.
DEP: only YZ250 Silver Shorty (no part number or price); KTM 2023+ DEP not found.
Pro Circuit Platinum pipes for 2023+ KTM and current YZ125/YZ250: not found (RevZilla results were older models).
Akrapovič CRF450R/RX titanium slip-on (bikebiz.com.au): page shows no part number or years; not added.
Akrapovič 450 SX-F Evolution Line (full system) and Husqvarna/GasGas OEM-catalogue Akrapovič parts: not found this pass.
Wiseco 2023+ KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas two-stroke pistons, 2024+ KX450, 2025+ YZ450F, CRF250R and YZ250F: not found.
JE Pistons: only one KTM 450 SX-F kit with no years.
Hot Cams and Web Cams for 2023+ KTM group and newer Japanese bikes: not found.
Kibblewhite: Parts Europe 'Valve Spring Kit' 09260137 had no brand or fitment; not added.
Lightspeed: no intake or airbox products found.
not_done: Arrow and Doma beyond one search each
Athena gasket kits and Athena 2-stroke kits
Twin Air GasGas MC-F Powerflow page
